blurb: Anniston’s Michael Tucker Park (6514 Weaver Rd, Anniston, AL 36206) currently serves as the southern terminus of the Chief Ladiga Trail. The park was named in memory Dr. Michael Tucker, a noted Anniston physician and long-time bicycle enthusiast.
